object.description: Setup: (a) ANT+ strap paired, ANT+ service app uninstalled; (b) ANT+ strap paired, phone without ANT+ radio. Steps: 1. Select Start in each case. 2. Wait 2 min. Expected: The matching status (plugin missing, no ANT+ adapter) stays shown and the status never returns to searching in the 2 min. Sensor error cannot be induced and is verified by PACE-STS-75.
